posts.zh:
dsh-restart-fab 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。DSH 网页界面右下角的一键重启按钮：全屏遮罩原地重启 dsh 进程并自动刷新页面；无需启动脚本，跨 Windows/macOS/Linux。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-241182cad0e3e4fed8a4.html
posts.en:
dsh-restart-fab is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Floating restart button for the DSH web GUI: restarts the dsh process in place with a full-screen overlay and auto-reloads the page; no launcher script required, works on Windows/macOS/Linux.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-241182cad0e3e4fed8a4.html
